title: Update on the .FURRY new gTLD
summary: The gTLD Club reports a new set of publicly announced 2026 Round applications, including the .FURRY application and other newly disclosed strings.

title: Applicant for .PORTAL, .ISLAND and .TRUCK
summary: Vant Nexus Technologies LLC has publicly announced applications for .PORTAL, .ISLAND and .TRUCK in the 2026 ICANN new gTLD Round.

title: Unliked — Chinese gTLD calls it quits
summary: Domain Incite reports that Qihoo 360 has asked ICANN to terminate the registry agreement for .xihuan, a 2012-round gTLD that never launched.

title: .phone domain gets launch dates
summary: Domain Incite reports launch plans for .phone, including a sunrise period beginning October 6, followed by an Early Access Period and general availability.

title: New gTLDs: what we do and don’t know about the 2026 round
summary: Domain Incite reviewed the state of the just-closed application window and noted that the complete confirmed application count and full string list would follow later program milestones.
